reference: Original unrounded FP32 x, y, weight, bias on P800. Per output finite and RMSE, max_abs, max_normalized <= FP16 eager vs same reference. normalized_error=abs_error/(0.0003+0.0003*abs(reference)).
timing: Original same-device FP32 eager reference; three per-output errors <= FP16 eager. Checked public candidate call, supplied FP16 output buffers. Two-step writes residual with add.out and copies layer_norm to supplied output. Eager returns newly allocated outputs. Warm single synchronized calls, balanced randomized order; compilation excluded.
scope: Standalone guarded KL3 dual-output entry. No SDK default dispatch change. Perf measurements in microseconds.

causal_measurement.device_protocol: 18 balanced trials of 32 C-submitted launches, event microseconds per launch. Hot fixed buffers. Controls keep traffic and operations where indicated. Costs overlap.

limits: The vendor wheel supplies machine images, not the vendor compiler IR. The eager intermediate is a live ATen dispatch trace. Static mnemonics include runtime code and do not give dynamic instruction counts.
DMA controls copy 32 MiB of matrix payload plus the two affine vectors with warm addresses; events do not isolate HBM bandwidth. Empty barriers are part of the cross-core exchange comparison.
Submission and post-return synchronization overlap device execution. Prefilled eager intervals and native-batched device intervals have different command boundaries.
